items.content:
UHC ranked rubric :uhc:
Evaluation tests:
An evaluation test is a test in which a player LT3 or below will have there skill evaluated by a LT3 tier tester, the test is First to 5 rounds and you must win at least 4 rounds to guarantee yourself LT3.

:warn_red:  Missing opponents:
For every missing opponents you must fight 2 players in the tier below, for example if you are bridging to HT3 and there are no HT3s available to fight you, you must fight 4 LT3s by a score of 5-2 or better against each player.

items.title: 🏆 LT1 → HT1
items.content:
LT1 → HT1
10 rounds:

Phase 1: Beat two opponents in the Tier below you. Don't let anyone get more than 6 rounds on you.

Phase 2: Beat two opponents in the same Tier as you with at least a 20-14 overall score.

Phase 3: Beat the HT1 Player. If successful you will receive HT1.

items.title: 🏆 HT2 → LT1
items.content:
HT2 → LT1
First to 10:

Phase 1: Beat 2 opponents in the same Tier as you with at least a 20-14 overall score.

Phase 2: Achieve an equal or better total score against 2 players in the Tier you are testing for. You must get a minimum of 7 rounds on each opponent.

:medalla2: LT2 → HT2
Phase 1: Beat two opponents in the same Tier as you with at least a 20-14 overall score.
Phase 2: Achieve an equal or better score against two players in the Tier you are testing for. You must get a minimum of 7 rounds on each opponent.

items.title: 🥈 HT3 → LT2
items.content:
HT3 → LT2

Phase 1: Beat two opponents in the same Tier as you with at least a 20-14 overall score.

Phase 2: Achieve an equal or better score against two players in the Tier you are testing for. You must get a minimum of 7 rounds on each opponent.

items.title: 🥉 Testing for HT3
items.content:
Phase 1: If you beat your Evaluation Tester 5-3 or better, you may test for HT3 by creating a ticket. 

Phase 2: Get at least 7 rounds off your HT3 opponent in a first to 10 duel (7-10).
